column1: # Alignment between cv2pm stage snapshots and UB model debug artifacts.
# numbering is stable when options change the pass set, so alignment is keyed on
# the stage NAME plus which occurrence of it (1-based), not on the ordinal.
# Only stages where both sides have a snapshot of the same program point can be
# aligned.  The model has finer-grained artifacts (dimension analysis, semantic
# IR bridges) with no cv2pm counterpart; those are intentionally absent here.
#   cv2pm_stage        <phase>-<name> exactly as cv2pm names the snapshot
#   model_stage        model pass name as it appears in the artifact filename
#   model_occurrence   1-based occurrence of that pass name in the model run
#   note               why the two points correspond
